messages:
Mira (AE): Deal-desk request: Orchid Industries wants a 24mo Dedicated commit. List $1.2M/yr. They're asking 38% off, net60, and a 6-week implementation credit. They say they'll be a marquee reference. Need quick guidance.

Chris (Finance): 38% is above our standard. What are their expansion projections and payment security?

Mira (AE): They project 2.5x ARR in 12 months. They offered a parent company PO but request net60. No investor guarantee. Sales is proposing 30% + 40% upfront to compromise.

Dana (Sales Ops): Quick math: list 1.2M. 30% -> 840k, 38% -> 744k. Recommend 30% with 40% upfront or allow 35% only if prepaid 50%. Precedent risk otherwise.

Riley (Legal): Net60 ok if signatory verified. Implementation credit must be capped and scoped; any dev work billed separately. Add late payment fees. Legal needs final redlines ~48hrs.

collections-bot: Reminder: run credit check and attach risk score in ticket before approving net60.

Chris (Finance): For Marin: propose approval path: finance can approve up to 30% with 40% upfront; 31-35% requires CFO sign-off with 50% prepay and margin floor check; >35% requires exec committee.

Mira (AE): I'll ask customer for 40% prepay or parent PO with verified credit. If they push, I'll request co-marketing and strict renewal price guardrails.

Marin (CFO): I won't approve >35% without exec committee. I can approve up to 35% only if 50% prepaid, credit OK, legal & SRE sign-off on implementation impact, and margin floor >=40% after costs. Document all conditions in deal desk ticket.

Chris (Finance): Noted. Marking ticket as "needs CFO sign-off" if they accept less than our proposed prepay.

Mira (AE): Thanks team 74. Will update when customer responds.
